item.title: Harkla Recalls Children’s Sensory Swings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
item.company: Sold At: Sensory Tool House, Hammer & Jacks, Loaded Sensory and Renew (Faire), and online at Amazon.com and Harkla.co from March 2020 through December 2025 for between $100 and $130.
item.brand: Sold At: Sensory Tool House, Hammer & Jacks, Loaded Sensory and Renew (Faire), and online at Amazon.com and Harkla.co from March 2020 through December 2025 for between $100 and $130.
item.summary: This recall involves Harkla’s children’s sensory swings. The compression swings have a blue fabric seat and come with a four-hole hook and ceiling mounting hardware for suspension, with a drop length of 18 to 24 inches. Only swings with a four-hole hook are included in this recall. SKU number LS-COMP-1BLU or LS-COMP-1BLU-SW is printed on the side of the product packaging.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Harkla Sensory Swings.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
